newsitem.title: USA: USG spot jet diffs dip, NYMEX slides. [corrected 01:16 gmt]
newsitem.headline: USG spot jet diffs dip, NYMEX slides. [corrected 01:16 gmt]

text.p: U.S. Gulf (USG) spot heating oil prices slid lower (corrects from "were stronger") Tuesday as both differentials and NYMEX prices weakened.
NYMEX heating oil prices, the basis for jet prices, fell 1.10 cent by the close.
USG 54-grade barrels for the back 3rd cycle on the Colonial Pipeline changed hands at 3.25 cents, down about 0.50 cent (corrects from "a gain of more than 1.50 cents) from Monday's levels.
USG fourth cycle barrels were talked between 0.75 and 1.00 cent over NYMEX, also about 0.50 cent down.
New York Harbor (NYH) prompt 54-grade was talked between 7.25 and 7.50 cents over the screen, nearly unchanged from Monday.
